Anthony Trollope, Framley Parsonage.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/anthony-trollope/framley-parsonage

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Anthony Trollope, the author, died 1882 (citizenship: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland).

First publication of the text used: 1861 (SE colophon: 'Framley Parsonage was published in 1861 by Anthony Trollope.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1861, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1956.
- Country of origin (the country of first publication is not named in the facts): the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1882.
